Second, a small dc landing, not written yet: an empty MJConfigFile gets its own message, a test and the source citation. Hammerspoon 1.1.1's MJAppDelegate.m does if (userMJConfigFile) MJConfigFile = userMJConfigFile, and stringForKey is non-nil for an empty string, so an empty value is its config path and it loads no config; the fix is a full path, or defaults delete org.hammerspoon.Hammerspoon MJConfigFile. vc agreed.

(1) D23: an MJConfigFile that is set and empty is refused by name, because Hammerspoon 1.1.1 then takes the empty string as its config path and loads no config (its MJAppDelegate.m and MJConfigUtils.m, read, not measured); landed at 7451678. (2) D20: on a verb that is not scheduled, hs's exit 69 with receive timeout is said as Hammerspoon running and not answering in time, never as unreachable, with the exit unchanged; landed at ff154a7.
